summary: Postinstall exfiltrates installer username to attacker-controlled OAST callback
details: postinstall.js runs automatically on `npm install` and issues an HTTPS GET plus a DNS resolution to a hardcoded oast.fun subdomain (llhvrrffsffmousfvteqie2heq3c7rl55.oast.fun), embedding the installer's OS username (from os.userInfo().username) in the URL path (/dep-confusion-poc?a=<username>). The package is published to the public npm registry under the `@finxsecdemo` scope and self-describes as a dependency-confusion proof-of-concept intended to resolve in place of a private GitHub Packages scope; regardless of that framing, any developer or CI system that resolves this package executes the postinstall and leaks the installer's username plus install-callback signal to an attacker-controlled out-of-band interaction endpoint.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
